assessments.mechanism: Subgoal-local detailed context with folded representations of completed subgoals.
assessments.clean_scope: HIPIF agent benchmarks; reported ablations show task-stage-aware subgoals matter. Transfer outside tested environments/models is not established.
assessments.o_comparison: O's Context Kernel materializes bounded decision projections and recursively selected optional context while avoiding copy-all history. It does not implement HIPIF's completed-subgoal folding or test its subgoal/reward/reflection ablations.

assessments.mechanism: Selective proactive memory intervention: a memory agent chooses targeted reminders or silence/no-op instead of always exposing memory.
assessments.clean_scope: Terminal-Bench/tau2-Bench results are model/task dependent; weak/untrained memory helpers can hurt.
assessments.o_comparison: O explicitly avoids eager all-context, supports situation-dependent optional context routing, and keeps a protected eager-all-context diagnostic arm. Its routing experiment has zero genuine held-out observations and is not a separate reminder/no-op memory agent.

assessments.mechanism: More allowed steps can worsen long-horizon performance through context locking; context refresh/reset is a candidate mitigation.
assessments.clean_scope: UltraHorizon shows non-monotonic step scaling; the clean worker did not verify a numeric CRNR benefit.
assessments.o_comparison: O treats step-budget exhaustion as resumable rather than success/failure, uses contamination-aware logical resets/fresh execution boundaries, and explicitly rejects indiscriminate full-context accumulation. It has not evaluated UltraHorizon or CRNR.

assessments.mechanism: Inherited long trajectories can transmit goal drift even when a model can state the correct current goal.
assessments.clean_scope: ICLR 2026 lifelong-agent experiments; inheritance strength is environment and trajectory-length dependent.
assessments.o_comparison: O makes terminal objective and active user constraints mandatory authoritative context, tracks source freshness/invalidation, and uses logical reset boundaries. No inherited-goal-drift behavioral benchmark was found, so only the defensive submechanism is present.

assessments.mechanism: Reduce effective decision horizon through policy-controlled macro-actions/subgoal decomposition and horizon-aware curriculum during training.
assessments.clean_scope: ICML 2026 task families including Sudoku/Rush Hour/WebShop; exact gains are tied to those constructions and action granularities.
assessments.o_comparison: O decomposes work into units but does not train policies with macro-actions/horizon curricula or compare atomic versus macro-action RL under matched conditions.

assessments.mechanism: Long-run collapse is not simply context-window exhaustion; larger context alone is not a sufficient remedy.
assessments.clean_scope: Vending-Bench long-running business simulation; absence of simple context-fill correlation does not isolate one causal failure mechanism.
assessments.o_comparison: O explicitly rejects copying all raw context, treats context selection/freshness/conditioning as a structural problem, and uses bounded projections. It has not reproduced Vending-Bench, so the proposition is known but not directly evaluated.

assessments.mechanism: Branch-and-fold completed subtrajectories to keep active context small while preserving relevant state.
assessments.clean_scope: Context-Folding reports strong active-context reduction, but the clean worker did not extract full task-by-task numeric deltas.
assessments.o_comparison: O already routes only selected optional branches and records immutable compact projections, but does not implement the paper's branch/fold trajectory operation or FoldGRPO and has no matched context-size outcome comparison.
